reviews.x: I loved how light weight this product is but adds so much! I carefully applied a small amount to the base of my lashes and pulled very little up. Once my lashes were close to drying I added a little more to my length. It takes me a couple of washes to remove al of it. Definitely easier to remove while in the shower because it comes off in little fragments not so much like a smear. The shower loosens it up. I haven’t seen damage to my lashes. Great price too!

I've tried a million different kinds of mascara and they all seem to smudge under my eyes through out the day.  This does NOT do that.  It is by far the best for lasting all day that I've been able to find.  We also ride motorcycles and it stays on even after a full day of riding.  This is my second purchase and I will definitely be ordering again.  Highly recommend.

Heading to Disney World and needed some waterproof mascara. This is great stuff. Got caught in the rain recently and the mascara stayed on the eyelashes. My middle granddaughter who is not old enough for makeup yet loved the packaging. It reminded her of unicorns. Thanks for a great product and the laughs shared with a precious 9-year-old. I'll be back for more.

Its the best mascara I used, definitely doubled length of my lashes, easy to apply, no clumpy. Very happy when I'm too busy to use false lashes! If you are looking for something longer, stick with false lashes (with glue).

First of all, the packaging is beautiful!  I was a little disappointed in the beginning because the product was a little too "wet" for a good application.  I had to apply, let dry, apply, let dry, and on and on so it would build up.  Once you use it for a few times, and the air dries it out a tiny bit it starts to apply much better.  The mascara lasts all day long, and looks just as good at the end of the day as it does in the beginning.  The tube lasts longer than most of the ones I have purcha

I haven’t worn mascara in over a year because I just got tired of it flaking, irritating my eyes, globbing two or more lashes together, etc. My lashes are not full but they are long, so mostly I just wanted color, dark gray if possible. Couldn’t find gray, or color only and am too shaky to try dye. So last week, I ordered 6 different brands of black mascara, all at very low cost. I’ve tried them all now, with one coat, with two coats, with remover pads and oil based remover, sleeping overnight w

Very nice. I used to use the thrive cosmetics mascara that has fibers in it but this one is just as good but a fraction of the cost. I use a lot of mascara and I don’t like water proof because hello for me it’s a pain to get off. But this one comes off rather easily. I use the makeup removing water and dhc cleansing oil and this comes right off. This came with 2 so I should be set for a while. It’s awesome.

This particular mascara separates your eyelashes quite well. I love how it looks so natural. I receive many compliments form coworkers and friends. On top of this, they have excellent customer service as I had contacted the vendor with an inquiry and received prompt and courteous assistance. I would definitely purchase this again.

This is a great mascara.  I have been using Too Faced Better Than Sex mascara for the past 2 years and since I couldn't get to Sephora,  I decided to try this brand.  I am glad that I did.  It is a quality product and gives me the full lashes without looking clumpy.  I will be ordering this again!

I have very sensitive eyes and can’t use a lot of mascaras.  I am very pleased with this product.  It hasn’t bothered my eyes at all, and I’m happy with the way it looks as well.  I take it off each night with coconut oil and it comes off easily but doesn’t smudge during the day.

I really like this product It definitely extends my lashes The brush is a little to big for what I like You really have to take time and remove a little product from brush to avoid lashes sticking together I have one to my granddaughter and she likes it also

I love this mascara.  Easy to apply and creates long, thick lashes.  The formula is amazing.  It does not smudge or flake.  I have bought a lot of expensive mascaras and this one definitely works much better at a third of the price!  Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Buy this product, it won’t disappoint
reviews.x: This mascara is the best I’ve used by far. My mascara of choice has been Bad Girl Bang by benefit, but let’s tell you... this mascara has definitely changed that. I love a natural long/full lash and this product definitely delivers.

I love this mascara. I have long natural eyelashes and it is so hard to find a good mascara that evenly coats my lashes. This mascara does not clump, easy to remove, waterproof and lasts all day. I highly recommend this!!

I love my new 4D Silk Fiber Mascara! It goes on easily, without clumping, and never smears under my eyes at the end of the day. Easy to remove with soap and water or make-up remover.  You won't be sorry you bought this!

I love my new 4D Silk Fiber Mascara! It goes on easily, without clumping, and never smears under my eyes at the end of the day. Easy to remove with soap and water or make-up remover.  You won't be sorry you bought this!

Such a great value. I have found this mascara is just as good as the 40.00 and up brands. It goes on easy. I don't have to dip the wand more than once. My eyelashes are not clumped together either. I love it!

reviews.t: This is the product that you need !
reviews.x: I was very skeptical before buying this product, but the first time I wore it, the difference it makes it’s outstanding! People were asking me if I was wearing falsies! Just two coats and that was it !

reviews.t: It is the real deal!!! Beautiful container an extra!!
reviews.x: Love this mascara!! Even after wearing it all day in Las Vegas at 100+ degrees it doesn’t smudge or wear off!! I am 65 years old and this makes my lashes look amazing!! (I Don’t take good selfies!)

reviews.t: Best silk fiber mascara by far!
reviews.x: I have tried several silk fibres mascaras. I really like this one. No smudges and doesn't cake up. A nice, even layer goes on at swipe 1, 2, 3, 4....applicator is long to get lashes in the corners.
I have to tell you that I am using this product since two weeks ago. It last the whole day, and it is very easy to remove. I will keep using it because the price is very good for the quality.
I really like this mascara.  The more you swipe on your lashes the more they look like falsies.  My lashes are so short so I’m excited to find a product that works for me.  Excellent value.
Works if you follow directions.  Had a problem with one of the tubes but the vendor got back to me exceptionally fast and corrected the problem.  Very impressed with their customer service
I thought it was good mascara but it came out of the tube in globs! They need to figure out how to fix that problem. It was definitely good at building length though.
Nice product and easy to use. Up until the pandemic, I normally wear eyelash extensions. Fiber mascara is what I’ve been using in its place. Beautiful packaging.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the mascara for not smudging or flaking and lasting all day, even through rain or motorcycle riding.
Many customers say it lengthens and thickens lashes without clumping, giving a natural full look.
Several reviewers find it easy to remove with soap, water, makeup remover, or coconut oil.
Some reviewers note the formula starts out too wet and requires letting it dry or removing excess product from the brush to avoid clumping or lashes sticking together.
A few customers mention sensitive eyes and appreciate that the product doesn't irritate them.
